name: remaining-condition-types
description: Pins down modifier conditions using atLeast, which conditionally change the max limit of constraints. Specifically tests the mutual exclusion of Spear Infantry and Halberds on Skeletons using atLeast conditions.

rosters.description: Skeletons unit with only Spear Infantry selected. Halberds are not selected, so the atLeast constraint modifier doesn't fire, leaving the max bound of Spear Infantry at 1.

Skeletons unit with both Spear Infantry and Halberds selected. Both entries have a max constraint of 1, and each has a modifier with an 'atLeast' condition that sets the other's max bound to 0. Since both are present, both atLeast conditions are satisfied, modifying both bounds to 0 and triggering both max constraints.
